messages:
violet-people-ops: Heads-up: launching "Rapid Intake" for SOC2/ISO attestation to cut review latency for micro-services (<= 8 files, single manifest). Optional.

omar-eng: Nice — does this change acceptance criteria?

violet-people-ops: No. Same criteria. Rapid Intake just standardizes packaging so reviewers can do a single-pass check.

maria-privacy: Confirmed: legal/privacy still require full proof if flags appear. Rapid Intake = intake convenience only.

omar-eng: How do teams qualify?

violet-people-ops: Services with no external user data flows, and teams under 8 ppl. If unsure, ping me or hana-hr.

hana-hr: Contractors ok, but include manager approval in the manifest.

omar-eng: Where to upload?

violet-people-ops: Evidence Portal -> Rapid Intake Q2-2026. Filename: <team>-rapidintake-q2-2026.zip. Manifest must be root README_manifest.md mapping files to controls.

attestation-bot: Automated linting active. Required tags: SOC2-2026, ISO27001-2026, rapid-intake. First intake deadline: 2187660000 (7 days). Office hours Tue 14:00 PT (link in portal).

leo-cto: Small ask: include a pointer to the production SLO dashboard in the manifest to speed verification.

maria-privacy: Added: manifest field slo_dashboard_link is required. If none, put N/A.

omar-eng: Any change to training/attestations?

violet-people-ops: Training unchanged. New "fast attestation" available for folks with training in last 6 months — 4-question form. Eligible employees will get an email.

hana-hr: If you need manual eligibility, DM me with training date.

violet-people-ops: We'll publish a one-page checklist + manifest template in the Evidence Portal repo and open a PR to pin it to common repos.

violet-people-ops: TL;DR: Rapid Intake = optional, <=8 files + manifest, same validation, upload to Evidence Portal, office hours next week. DM or join office hours for questions. :rocket:
